name: talent-signal
description: Read supplied candidate conversations and return evidence-backed, proposal-only momentum packets.

interface.shortDescription: Review candidate evidence without executing actions.
interface.longDescription: Analyze synthetic or user-authorized candidate conversation content, preserve exact evidence and ambiguity, and propose one recruiter-owned next step or no action. The plugin cannot confirm state or perform external writes.
defaultPrompt: Review this authorized candidate conversation and propose one safe next step.
Check this synthetic conversation for ambiguity and return no action when appropriate.
